card.name: Generic noun after a drug or material type
card.fires_on: The generic noun that finishes a short compound, mostly "agent" after a drug class (contrast, antithrombotic, anesthetic) and "formula" after infant. It also fires on "samples" after stool and on "mix"/"mixed" in preparation steps.

modes.label: Agent after drug class
modes.description: The word "agent" ends a drug-class phrase such as contrast, antithrombotic, chemotherapeutic or local anesthetic.
modes.example: The in vitro interaction between nevirapine and the antithrombotic<< agent>> warfarin is complex.

modes.label: Infant formula and samples
modes.description: A material noun such as "formula" or "samples" follows a modifier like infant or stool.
modes.example: , mix the recommended number of REYATAZ oral powder packets with 10 mL of prepared liquid infant<< formula>>.

modes.label: Mixing verbs
modes.description: The verb mix or mixed appears in preparation or compatibility instructions.
modes.example: ELAHERE must not be<< mixed>> with any other drugs or intravenous fluids

card.plain: It marks the noun that completes a phrase like "contrast agent" or "infant formula", and also mixing instructions.
